steps.what: Check supplies and determine the exact items and quantities needed
Populate the supply order with the chosen items and quantities
Check suitability, budget, supplier, and quantities before submitting the supply order
Check delivered supplies and raise missing or incorrect items

tasks.design: Use a saved catalogue order form in {PROCUREMENT} to populate the assistant's explicit supply choices. Keep physical stock checks, clinical suitability, purchase approval, and receipt checking with people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated order entry can follow an already completed item-and-quantity decision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue forms can populate exact approved item fields.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unsuitable substitutions and anticipating patient-specific supply needs.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant knows when a catalogue match would not serve the intended treatment activity.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated order entry; stock and suitability decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native catalogue forms can reuse explicit item and quantity choices without inferring clinical need; this is an E1 design estimate.

assumptions: Boundary includes assistant supply ordering and receipt checks, excluding supplier fulfilment and purchasing work outside existing assistant authority.

Assistant produces item identifier, specification, unit, quantity, needed-by date, delivery location, and cost centre in s1; capture time remains fully counted. Purchasing team maintains existing catalogue item-to-supplier fields. Missing or conflicting fields require manual order entry.
No par level or inferred stock count is assumed. Supplier delivers after s3 and before s4 through unchanged fulfilment work.
Test native catalogue forms before custom software. If budget approval belongs elsewhere, retain that existing approval rather than enlarging assistant authority.
research_questions: Does preparing the explicit requirement list plus checking the draft take less time than current entry?

already_counted.description: Check the exact order and inspect its delivery

incremental.description: Maintain saved order choices and report catalogue mismatches
Correct catalogue mappings for therapy supplies

approvals.approved_version: Exact supplier, items, quantities, prices, delivery location and order version; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross 20 minus 6 focal upkeep gives net 14. Range assumes repeated catalogue orders; unusual supplies or already populated forms may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Schedule appointments and document administrative and billing information

steps.what: Collect required administrative data and agree appointment details with the patient
Send appointment confirmations and reminders using the agreed details
Populate health insurance billing documentation from confirmed service and administrative fields
Check billing documentation and resolve scheduling, data, or claim exceptions

tasks.design: Configure appointment notifications and billing-document population in the practice system {OTHER}. The assistant captures and confirms the exact source fields, checks exceptions, and hands billing documentation to the existing claim-submission owner.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notification and billing fields can be copied manually after they are already known.
tasks.enabler_now: Native practice-system functions can reuse confirmed appointment and treatment records.
tasks.still_hard: Incorrect patient details, missing authorisation, and disputed services.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant clarifies exceptions with patients and the responsible therapist rather than inventing missing data.
tasks.altitude: Less routine copying and reminder sending, with more attention to administrative exceptions.

reach.learn: Required claim fields and correction procedures

evidence.claim: Intramed practice software supports patient appointment confirmations and reminders.
Intramed billing software checks claims before sending through VECOZO; this supports native billing functions, not guaranteed coverage or autonomous clinical coding.
The proposed reduction in assistant copying and sending effort is an E1 scenario without local measured time data.

assumptions: Boundary covers assistant clerical effort across appointment and billing episodes; these are a workload mix, not a mandatory sequence for each patient. Treatment delivery, clinical notes, and final insurer submission are separate existing work.

OTHER is the practice-management system. Assistant captures and checks patient identifier, verified contact address, agreed appointment time, therapist, location, notification preference, message template version, and reminder timing in s1; that work remains counted and forms the exact notification approval. Failed identity or contact checks require manual contact.

Responsible therapist produces the existing confirmed treatment record before billing work: service date, procedure code, provider, units and authorisation reference where needed. Assistant checks these against patient and payer identifiers in s1; no code, attendance or coverage is inferred. Missing fields require therapist clarification and manual documentation.

Test native booking, notification, and billing functions first; existing runtime earns no labour saving. Savings require actual current manual sending and copying. Billing owner retains unchanged submission responsibilities.
research_questions: Do native functions reduce active assistant effort after source checking, failed messages, and billing exceptions are counted?

already_counted.description: Check records and resolve clerical exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain notification settings and billing field mappings
Check template and claim mapping changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient contact, appointment, message template version and reminder schedule confirmed in s1; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55; gross 45 minus 10 focal upkeep gives net 35. Range assumes substantial current manual reminders and billing copying; already configured practices may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The assistant can reduce repeated order and administrative entry while retaining source capture, suitability checks, and patient-facing exceptions.
role.ambitious_version: An assistant who keeps supplies and administration reliable without turning incomplete records into automatic clinical or billing decisions.
